job.value: Grab a S$10 flash deal on a home service during the 10.10 campaign

arrivedFrom.value: The Services nav item or a 10.10 campaign banner

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Home & Services', the '10.10 Home Services MEGA DEAL' art and 'S$10 Flash deals (10-14 Oct)' make the purpose immediate.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The red 'Book now' on the 'Ongoing deal' card with its countdown is the loudest thing below the hero.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Book now', 'Share' and 'Notify me' each say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Selling fast', '49 left!' and 'Limited to first 100 users' are plain.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The choice is book now or get notified, which the buyer can make from the price and timing shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each deal card shows only service, price, strike price and stock; the hero subtitle is a single line.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Hero, countdown and deal cards all serve a campaign landing.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Prices ('S$10/hr S$16/hr'), the countdown and buttons carry it with almost no prose.
